scope: AWESWELL LIMITED / Sun Rock / Montaña Roja Capital Programme + SRLN-2026
public_projection: Alias and continuity rules only; private source locators and contents remain access-controlled.
rules: All related human, ChatGPT, Codex and automation work uses this one existing canonical Drive folder.
Resolve the exact folder ID through the private resolver; verify it and read 00_START_HERE before substantive Drive work.
Folder identity is the Drive folder ID, not its display name or a ChatGPT thread title.
Read current file versions and source-status qualifications; update existing file IDs rather than creating parallel canonical copies.
Do not create a replacement canonical folder on access failure. Record ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE and preserve a clearly labelled local draft for later reconciliation.
Search, hash-check and reconcile legacy sources before migration. Archives, legal-source vaults, backups and investor-release staging retain their distinct roles.
A change to the canonical folder requires an explicit owner instruction and coordinated updates to both repositories, the Drive index and saved continuity instructions.
Refresh current main and the Drive index on every resumed thread. Chat memory accelerates retrieval but is not a file-version authority.
Do not expand sharing, publish private documents, or treat an alias/link as permission to access or disclose them.
This control does not retroactively synchronize already-running or disconnected threads; they must reload it.

The canonical Programme Register is the controlling blind-spot and readiness surface. Do not create a competing public tracker; public GitHub retains only continuity-safe pointers and status language.

NewCo financial history, issuer incorporation/borrowing authority, LSEG admission, provider appointments, identifiers, guarantees, security, tax incentives and Spanish transaction approvals remain evidence-gated and must not be inferred from preparatory drafts.
private_recipient_workspaces: Use the same folder; personal recipient identifiers are withheld from this public projection.
website_effect: Repository/bootstrap control only. No website navigation, sitemap, investor access or deck publication is changed.

private_blind_spot_control.note: The existing private canonical Programme Register remains the control surface. The blind-spot sweep is additive, does not create a second tracker or new CP universe, and its detailed transaction/legal contents remain private.
